title: Add OpenCode CLI routing support and compatible upgrade guidance
acceptance_criteria: init accepts opencode as the default CLI and as a per-role override, and validate accepts the saved configuration.
activate accepts an OpenCode default override without changing per-role routes or project configuration.
Worker and smoke prompts resolve OpenCode owner and reviewer routes independently while legacy routes and invalid-agent rejection remain unchanged.
All bundled skill versions are 0.1.5; setup, routing and README document OpenCode and execution-host readiness checks without claiming a live worker ran.
test_seams: Bootstrap CLI init, validate and activate plus rendered worker/smoke prompts; tests do not start real agents or mutate Orca.

documentation.assessment: CLI routing expands to OpenCode. Update README and canonical routing/setup instructions. No application requirements, API/data contracts, UI, architecture or release deployment change. Requirement IDs are not applicable to process configuration. The user explicitly requested core extension on 2026-10-24, authorizing the required protected core.json version bump as a maintenance exception; scope must still report that protected path rather than bypass it. Consumer project routing and installation are applied under the same direct user request.

updates.change: Document OpenCode CLI selection and compatible 0.1.5 upgrade.
Document OpenCode routing with provider-specific launch and readiness limits.
Offer OpenCode as a default or per-role CLI.
